title: Understanding the Foramen Magnum
text: The foramen magnum is the large opening at the base of the skull through which the spinal cord passes. Its position determines how the head is positioned relative to the spine.

title: Quadruped vs Biped Balance
text: In quadrupeds (four-legged animals), the head projects forward and muscles at the back of the neck hold it up. In bipeds, the head needs to balance on top of the spine - think about where the 'pivot point' should be for this to work efficiently.
